ClusterName.Description: EKS cluster name for HelloDJ workloads (Decision D1).

BakedGpuAmiId.Description: Pre-baked minimal NixOS GPU AMI id for the Karpenter transcode NodePool (task 16.2). Placeholder until the pipeline injects the registered id.

GpuIdleWindowSeconds.Description: GPU scale-to-zero idle window (seconds) for the shared transcode GPU NodePool consolidateAfter (R8.5, default 300, range 60-900).

GpuScaleUpLimit.Description: Max time-sliced nvidia.com/gpu units the shared transcode GPU NodePool scales up to on GPU-requiring workload arrival (R8.6).
